# Example transcript: running s10's model/provider config + retry + streaming.
#
# This is an ILLUSTRATIVE run, not a byte-exact fixture — the LLM reply is
# non-deterministic. What matters is the SHAPE: a name resolves to a config, a
# provider is built + wrapped in retries, and the reply comes back (optionally
# streamed). The tests pin the deterministic parts (lookup, retry backoff, SSE
# decode, translation) with fakes; this file shows what a real run looks like.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Inspect the registry. No network, no key needed.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$ go run . -list
Known models and aliases (resolve with -model):
  4o                         -> gpt-4o
  claude-haiku-4-5           backend=anthropic ctx=200000  format=whole
  claude-opus-4-7            backend=anthropic ctx=200000  format=diff
  claude-sonnet-4-6          backend=anthropic ctx=200000  format=diff
  deepseek                   -> deepseek-chat
  deepseek-chat              backend=openai    ctx=64000   format=diff
  deepseek-reasoner          backend=openai    ctx=64000   format=diff
  gpt-4o                     backend=openai    ctx=128000  format=diff
  gpt-4o-mini                backend=openai    ctx=128000  format=whole
  groq                       -> llama-3.3-70b-versatile
  haiku                      -> claude-haiku-4-5
  ...

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Resolve the `sonnet` alias and send one message, verbosely.
#    (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY must be set.)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$ export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...
$ go run . -v -model sonnet "say hi in one short sentence"

# --- stderr (the -v trace) ---
[s10] model=claude-sonnet-4-6 backend=anthropic url=- ctx=200000 format=diff stream=false
[s10] retries on: base=125ms cap=32s maxRetries=6
[s10] stop_reason=end_turn in=14 out=9 tokens

# --- stdout ---
Hi there, I'm online and ready to help!

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Stream the reply (Anthropic backend). Tokens print as they arrive; the
#    decoder reassembles them into one response under the hood.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$ go run . -model sonnet -stream "count to five"
One, two, three, four, five.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Swap to an OpenAI-compatible backend. ONLY the config row changes — the
#    provider boundary translates the wire format; retries wrap it identically.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$ export DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-...
$ go run . -v -model deepseek "explain a goroutine in one line"
[s10] model=deepseek-chat backend=openai url=https://api.deepseek.com/v1 ctx=64000 format=diff stream=false
[s10] retries on: base=125ms cap=32s maxRetries=6
[s10] stop_reason=end_turn in=17 out=24 tokens
A goroutine is a lightweight, runtime-scheduled thread you start with the `go` keyword.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Transient failure shape: a 429 (rate limit) or 5xx is retried with
#    doubling backoff; a 400 (bad request) fails fast. The retry trace below is
#    what the -v decorator log looks like when the provider returns a 503 twice
#    before succeeding (illustrative — the live server controls this).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#   anthropic API 503: overloaded
#   ... retry 1 after 125ms
#   anthropic API 503: overloaded
#   ... retry 2 after 250ms
#   stop_reason=end_turn in=14 out=9 tokens
#   Hi there!

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Unknown model: a typed error that lists the known names, exit code 2.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$ go run . -model gpt-9-ultra "hi"
unknown model "gpt-9-ultra"; known: 4o, claude-haiku-4-5, claude-opus-4-7, ...
exit status 2

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. The deterministic tests (these DO run in CI, no network):
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$ go test ./...
ok  	learn-aider/s10	0.5s
